Package com.nexuslink.protocol.s3

Class S3Uri

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.s3.S3Uri
public final class S3Uri extends Object
Pure, offline S3 object-location parser (no AWS SDK). Understands the three common ways an S3 object is addressed and normalises them into {bucket, key, region, endpoint, style}:
  • the AWS CLI scheme s3://bucket/key/with/slashes (key optional);
  • virtual-hosted-style URLs such as https://bucket.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/key or https://bucket.s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/key;
  • path-style URLs such as https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/bucket/key and generic custom endpoints like http://localhost:4566/bucket/key (LocalStack / MinIO).
The parsed key is URL-decoded; toS3Uri() renders the canonical s3://bucket/key.
